cases.label: limit
cases.note: Post-errata reading: BYMONTHDAY limits, so only the month of DTSTART survives.

cases.label: expand
cases.note: Pre-errata reading: BYMONTHDAY expands across all twelve months. python-dateutil implements the pre-errata text.

expectation.note: A Verified erratum against the canonical expansion table describes behaviour the most widely deployed reference implementation does not exhibit.

normative_evidence.note: Verified, classified Editorial, but it changes expansion semantics
normative_evidence.quote: Note 2: Limit if BYYEARDAY or BYMONTHDAY is present; otherwise, special expand for YEARLY.

rationale: 'Conform to RFC 5545 plus verified errata' and 'match the ecosystem' are mutually exclusive goals, and this vector is where that becomes measurable. The most-linked HTML mirror of §3.3.10 still serves the pre-errata text, so implementers reading the ordinary web copy never see the correction.
title: FREQ=YEARLY with BYMONTHDAY only (erratum 3747's Note 2)
